reviews.author: R Chandra Prathap
reviews.text:
The quality of the packaging is very good and beautiful, this watch is definitely made of top quality materials, very well assembled and made, the case has excellent detail, a sense of depth that can only be seen in an expensive watch. All materials are well made, especially the hands and case. I was worried that it was made of regular silicone and would be hard/stiff, but the watch texture is soft and sturdy. The movement of the hands is subtle and well adjusted. The watch has far exceeded my expectations so far and I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: S.Akilesh
reviews.text:
This is a great watch, and for those of us who like to wear and collect big watches, it is exactly what I expected. I have no problem scrubbing my hands with it on, but I take it off in the shower. That's not unreasonable, as in principle it can withstand up to 30 meters of pressure; but if water gets in there somewhere then all watches can run out of water, and this one doesn't look exactly like that. But as they say it's better to take precautions than to take risks, and I really like this watch and don't want to take any chances with it. It's a great watch, in short I highly recommend it if you like to wear big, unique, subtle, precious and precise watches and like to collect watches .
